data.location: 1810 S Catalina Ave, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
data.short_description: Longstanding Hermosa Beach restaurant Martha's is expanding to the Riviera Village in Redondo Beach, taking over a 5,000 sq ft space formerly occupied by Gabi James. The Martha's team is preparing the space and co-owner Hilary Condren cited the area's vibrant outdoor dining culture as a key draw. The new location will include private event space upstairs and a newly appointed executive chef.

data.status: hoping to open in a month or later
data.short_description: Co-owners Mohamad and Ali Sobh are planning to open Bayroot Bakery in a developing shopping plaza in Dearborn. The bakery will focus primarily on breakfast items and pastries, likely with a Lebanese cuisine focus. No menu or social media accounts have been released yet.

data.status: set to reopen in the fall of 2026
data.short_description: PJ's Coffee is converting a former Starbucks on Maple Street into a new location, with significant interior and exterior renovations underway. The brand had closed its flagship Maple Street location in January 2025. The new location will retain the large patio and off-street parking.

A 1,000 sq ft cocktail lounge called Hearsay Social Club is opening inside the Circa 1857 antique shop in Baton Rouge. Owner Garrett Kemp designed the concept to add a revenue stream and attract foot traffic back to the retail setting. The menu will focus on inventive, one-of-a-kind cocktails using fresh, high-quality ingredients, plus beer, wine, and small bar snack plates.

data.event_date: End of June or early July 2026
data.short_description: Franchise group Who Brew is opening a new 7 Brew location in Waukegan, with construction wrapping up imminently. The shop will serve hot and cold brew coffees, energy drinks, fizz drinks, teas, lemonades, and shakes. This is part of Who Brew's continued expansion across Chicagoland, which now has over 20 Illinois locations.
Article covers a recurring Wine vs. Beer dinner event at an existing restaurant (Tio Lucho's). No new opening or closure is reported.

data.location: 2851 E Eastland Center Dr, Suite 5, West Covina, CA 91791
data.short_description: Changan Kitchen is expanding to the Eastland Center in West Covina, marking its sixth location. Owner Rachel Geng said they are awaiting final inspections before opening, which they hope will happen next month. The restaurant specializes in Chinese noodle dishes including Spicy Beef Noodle Soup and Dan Dan Noodles.

Cozy Soup 'n' Burger, a 54-year-old New York diner, announced it will permanently close on June 21, 2026, citing rising costs and declining business since the pandemic. The owner announced the closure via Instagram, stating "I tried, but I failed." The restaurant had launched a GoFundMe campaign in March in an attempt to stay afloat.

Owners Paloma Ramos and her husband are opening Mama Canela, a Tex-Mex restaurant, in Glendora Village to fill a perceived gap for upscale date-night dining in the area. The menu will feature fajitas, homemade flour tortillas, and craft cocktails, with the space transitioning from family-friendly to cocktail lounge atmosphere throughout the evening. A grand opening celebration with live mariachi music is planned for July 31.

data.location: 331 E Atlantic Ave, Delray Beach, FL 33483
data.status: grand opening celebration and ribbon-cutting event on June 6th and 7th, 2026
data.short_description: Boba tea chain Chatime is opening a new location on Atlantic Avenue in Delray Beach as part of its U.S. franchise expansion, targeting 20-plus locations by end of 2026. The location is owned by franchisee Erik Davis and will offer customizable beverages. Grand opening deals include free 16oz Premium Boba Milk Tea on June 6 and BOGO on June 6–7.

Queen & Rook Game Cafe is opening a second Philadelphia location in the Fairmount neighborhood, owned by Edward Garcia and Jeannie Wong. The new location will feature a "fantasy future" theme with retro flair, offering 1,000+ board games, inventive cocktails, and a food menu. No official opening date has been announced.

data.status: aiming to open by late summer or early fall
data.short_description: Homemade ice cream shop Scoop of Heaven, co-owned by Suzanne Pucci and Bill McDaniels, is expanding from its Elgin flagship to a new Lexington location. Construction recently began, with plans to rebuild the storefront to mirror the original. The shop will serve specialty flavors and a new vegan option, and a food truck launch is also planned in the coming weeks.

Panda Express opened a new location in Goodyear with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on May 22, 2026, attended by members of the Goodyear Chamber of Commerce. The brand gave free t-shirts to the first 88 guests and donated $1,000 to the Agua Fria Food & Clothing Bank. The opening continues the chain's expansion across the Phoenix metropolitan area.

Guzman y Gomez abruptly closed all eight of its Chicagoland locations on May 22, 2026, marking a full exit from the U.S. market after six years of operations. The Australia-based fast-casual Mexican-inspired chain cited unmet expansion expectations. A class-action lawsuit has been filed alleging failure to provide the required employee notice period.

The Melting Pot's Duluth location is closing on May 31, 2026, ending a 36-year run in the community. Owners are hosting a "Final Dip Celebration Weekend" from May 29–31 with a guest memory wall, commemorative keepsakes, and signature fondue. Other Melting Pot locations in Roswell, Kennesaw, and Midtown Atlanta will continue operating.

Vilebrequin La Plage has opened atop the UNFRAMED, Autograph Collection hotel in Miami Beach, marking the brand's U.S. debut. The rooftop destination is a collaboration between 34th Floor, Schulte F&B Group, and French swimwear brand Vilebrequin, offering French-inspired coastal cuisine, a rooftop lounge, and resort-style offerings. It is the fifth global outpost of the concept.

Japanese cheesecake and dessert cafe Uncle Fluffy opened its second Orange County location at Triangle Square in Costa Mesa on May 23, 2026. The cafe is known for its jiggly Japanese-style cheesecakes in original and specialty flavors, alongside espresso drinks and other beverages. The new store operates daily from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Grand Hyatt Nashville debuted slice/25, a new rooftop pizza-and-wine concept, on May 21, 2026, located on the 25th floor alongside existing rooftop bar lou/na. The menu features artisanal pizzas paired with curated wines, including a Margherita and a Soppressata + Hot Honey pizza. The space is walk-in only and operates during lou/na's regular hours.

A new Toastique location is opening in Johns Creek this summer, operated by husband-and-wife team Steve and Randi Rubin. The menu will feature gourmet toast, smoothies, superfood bowls, and cold-pressed juices. The location is positioned near schools and fitness studios aligned with the brand's health-focused customer base.

Local restaurateur Okan Ozyurteri is bringing Mediterranean restaurant Mozaika Mezze to Buckhead this fall. The restaurant will feature Turkish, Greek, and Lebanese flavors with small-plate mezze and wood-grilled skewers.

Bizarre Coffee Company is opening its fourth location in Downtown Acworth, currently under construction. The brand is known for specialty coffee and an eclectic, community-driven atmosphere, with cafes that often double as local art and event spaces.

data.status: projected opening date at some point in August
data.short_description: Chef Brad Feickert is opening Phia, an Appalachian-inspired restaurant, in the Takoma neighborhood of DC in the space previously occupied by La Mano Coffee Bar. The concept focuses on "Appalachian grassroots cuisine" honoring mountain life traditions, with a beverage program highlighting Appalachian-sourced ingredients. Opening is projected for late summer 2026.

data.location: Between I-95 and Austin Ridge Road, Stafford County, VA (zip not specified)
data.status: received approval; opening timeline not presently available
data.short_description: Buc-ee's has received approval from the Stafford County Board of Supervisors for a new 74,000 sq ft location in Stafford County, VA. The travel center will feature 120 fuel pumps and over 800 parking spaces. No opening timeline is currently available; the application had been under review for over two years.

data.location: 5063 Wellington Road, Gainesville, VA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Honeygrow is preparing to open a new location in Gainesville, Virginia at 5063 Wellington Road. The healthier fast-casual chain does not yet have a firm opening date but lists the location as "coming soon" on its website. Honeygrow currently operates 76 locations across 8 states.

data.location: Highland Drive and Nestle Way, beside Nestle factory, Jonesboro, AR (zip not specified)
data.status: anticipated to be up, running, and ready to greet customers in spring of 2027
data.short_description: The Southern Chef has announced its 8th area location, to be situated on Highland Drive and Nestle Way beside the Nestle factory in Jonesboro. The new location will also include a truck stop. The restaurant anticipates the space being open in spring of 2027.

Taco Prime announced via social media on May 22 its upcoming second location at 5201 Poplar Ave in Memphis, with signage already up. The building previously housed a Starbucks and most recently Abner's Famous Chicken. No opening timeline has been revealed.

data.location: 755 W Lee Dr, Baton Rouge, LA 70820
data.status: set to open; opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Cook Out is set to open its first Louisiana location at 755 W Lee Dr in Baton Rouge, in a building originally constructed for a Starbucks that never opened. An opening date has not been announced. Cook Out currently has more than 360 locations across the South.

data.location: 333 W St Louis Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89102
data.status: plan is to open this August
data.short_description: Lit Wings Express is expanding to the Lucky 3 Food Co ghost kitchen at 333 W. St. Louis Ave in Las Vegas, per a recently filed city permit. The new location will focus primarily on delivery and online ordering. The brand, started as a food truck in 2021, already operates two locations including one on Nellis Air Force Base.

data.location: 131 E Katella Ave, Suite 20, Anaheim, CA (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Burritos La Palma is opening a new location at 131 E Katella Ave, Suite 20 in Anaheim, per a plan review filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency. This will be the family-owned chain's sixth California location and third in Orange County. No opening date is mentioned in the article.

Cici's Pizza is expected to open a new location in the Jones Plaza at 10922 FM 1960 W in Houston, per a recently filed permit. Construction is slated to begin in late June and wrap up before the end of September, at an estimated cost of $300,000. The franchisee group is Aulakh Corporation, led by Ahmad T. Aulakh.

data.location: 3663 Las Vegas Blvd S, Unit #B018B, Las Vegas, NV 89109
data.status: slated to open this summer; construction currently underway
data.short_description: Te'Amo Boba & Dessert is set to debut in the Miracle Mile Shops at 3663 Las Vegas Blvd S, per a press release. Construction is underway and expected to wrap up soon for a summer opening. The women-owned, health-conscious boba and dessert café was founded in Chicago in 2016 and now has more than 20 locations nationwide.

Oakland Athletic Club is reopening at 59 Grand Ave under new ownership after a three-month closure, per a liquor license filing with the California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control. The bar, which first opened in 2018, was acquired by a group of six owners incorporated as OIAST, LLC, including restaurateur Chris Pastena. The previous owner announced its closure at the beginning of 2026.

data.status: should be open by this fall
data.short_description: Chama Gaúcha is set to open a second Houston-area location in Katy, per a recently filed permit, in a space formerly occupied by Doneraki Fuego y Mar Mexican Grill. Interior and exterior cosmetic renovations are slated to begin next week and wrap up by end of August, at an estimated cost of $200,000. The Brazilian steakhouse currently has locations in San Antonio, Chicago, Dallas, and Houston's Uptown District.

data.location: 2100 N Boulder Hwy, Henderson, NV 89011 (operating from 4D Commissary Roadhouse)
data.status: slated to pop up throughout Nevada
data.short_description: Cafe Calavera LV is a mobile café that will operate out of the 4D Commissary Roadhouse at 2100 N Boulder Hwy per a recently filed permit, serving primarily Henderson and available for private events. The brand was founded by Candice Gonzales and specializes in handcrafted coffee, refreshers, lemonades, matcha, and energy drinks inspired by Mexican heritage. No specific opening date is mentioned.

Infuse Wine is planned to open inside the Moncrief Lenoir campus at 2103 Lyons Ave, Suite 4101 in Houston's historic Fifth Ward, per a recently filed permit. Construction is slated to start in mid-July and wrap up by end of August at an estimated cost of $67,320 for the 1,683 sq ft space. Infuse Wine is distinguished as Houston's first wine infusion bar, founded by Krystal Spencer in 2021.

data.status: reopening its newly renovated taproom; opening timeline not yet announced
data.short_description: Mass Appeal Draught House & Grille is preparing to take over the former Wormtown Brewery space at 250 Patriot Place in Foxborough, per a general manager job listing from Hendler Family Brewing Company. The Hendler brothers purchased the space in 2024 and have been renovating it; a representative indicated additional details are expected to be shared the following week. No official opening timeline has been announced.

data.location: 32382 Del Obispo St, Suite C-1, San Juan Capistrano, CA 92675
data.short_description: Wade's Coffee House, self-described as California's first Country-Western coffee house, is preparing to open at 32382 Del Obispo St, Suite C-1 in San Juan Capistrano this fall, per a plan review filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency. The concept is owned by Colin and Chelsea McCrea and will blend specialty coffee with a Country-Western atmosphere. The coffee house is described as an homage to owner Colin's late father, "Wade."

Jersey Mike's is expected to open a new location in the Heights Marketplace at 436 W 19th St in Houston, per a recently filed permit. Demolition and construction are expected to start in mid-July and wrap up in mid-September, at an estimated cost of $300,000. The new location will bring Houston close to nearly 20 Jersey Mike's locations in the area.

data.location: 740 S Rampart Blvd, Suite 16, Las Vegas, NV 89145
data.short_description: Wagyu Factory is set to open its first Nevada location at 740 S. Rampart Blvd, Suite 16 in Boca Park, with construction already underway. The brand is operated by the Chubby Group, which currently runs four Wagyu Factory locations in California and one in Seattle. No official opening date has been announced, though a summer opening is suspected.

The Exchange, a new restaurant concept from NNE Hospitality Group, is set to take over the former Boston Chops space at 52 Temple Place in Downtown Crossing, per a report from Boston Restaurant Talk. Details about the concept remain limited, though the two-floor space features marble-clad walls and vaulted ceilings. The Boston Business Journal noted The Exchange could debut sometime in 2026.

data.status: shuttered both of its locations in early 2026
data.short_description: Boston Chops shuttered both of its locations in early 2026. The Downtown Crossing space at 52 Temple Place is now set to be taken over by a new concept called The Exchange. No further closure details are provided in the article.

data.status: preparing to debut later in the Fall of 2026
data.short_description: Vetra is a new restaurant set to open at The Elene boutique resort at 5091 Solano Ave in Napa, slated for Fall 2026. Led by chef Matthew Accarrino, the concept is inspired by Napa Valley's seasonal ingredients and live-fire cooking with Italian influence. It will feature nearly 20-foot ceilings, an open-air kitchen, and a large communal table linking the dining room and bar.

data.status: preparing to debut later in the Fall of 2026
data.short_description: A café is also set to debut at The Elene boutique resort at 5091 Solano Ave in Napa alongside Vetra, slated for Fall 2026. Intended as a gathering place for both hotel guests and local residents, it will be connected to the lobby and restaurant via a central courtyard with fountains and outdoor seating. No further details about the café's name or menu have been announced.

Kitanda Coffee & Açaí has a new Orlando location planned for 12028 Collegiate Way, Suite 110, per plan review paperwork submitted by Brazil Coffee Inc. The Brazilian coffee shop chain currently operates 14 locations, mostly in Washington with outposts in Kissimmee and Orlando. No opening date is specified in the article.

data.location: 5683 Red Bug Lake Road, Suite 9, Winter Springs, FL 32708
data.short_description: Artisanal smash-burger restaurant PCG Burgers is planning a second location in Winter Springs at Willa Springs shopping center. Plan review paperwork was submitted by PCG Winter Springs LLC. The co-owner was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: 811 Dickerson Pike, Unit B, Nashville, TN 37207
data.short_description: Founded by Jessica "Nettie" Simpson, Nettie's Spicy Chik has opened its first brick-and-mortar restaurant after building a following through a food truck launched in 2021. The restaurant held a soft opening on May 8 and a grand opening on May 23.

data.location: 150 Cranes Roost Blvd, Suite 1200, Altamonte Springs, FL 32701
data.short_description: Azal Coffee, founded in Dearborn, Michigan, is preparing for its Florida debut at Altamonte Springs. The owner confirmed a soft opening is planned for next month, with a grand opening to follow approximately one month after that.

Taco Prime is expanding from its original Bartlett location into a Cordova storefront that previously housed Guthrie's, which closed in February. Renovations are already underway, though no official opening timeline has been announced.

Mobile cafe Deja Brew Coffee is launching a permanent food truck location in St. Augustine featuring a walk-up window, seating area, kids' play area, and drive-thru. The location will serve the same menu as the existing mobile operation, including espresso drinks, cold brew, pastries, and the signature "Twisted Chiller."

data.location: 240 Rue Bossé, Chicoutimi, QC G7J 1L9, Canada
data.short_description: AUTUMN is a new market-driven, seasonally focused restaurant preparing to open inside Hôtel Château Cran Chaud in the former Café du Presbytère space. The project is a partnership among Sam Pinard, Natacha Fortin, and the hotel team, with approximately $80,000 invested in renovations.

Owners Josh and Lynn Marshall are opening a 3,500-square-foot all-day community cafe in Rogers Park featuring coffee, fresh food, a retail market, games, and a kids' area. The project raised over $32,000 through Kickstarter with strong community support.

Pirate Island Pizza and BBQ is a new mobile food operation preparing to open in Fernandina Beach, with plans to also operate at large events. Plan review paperwork was filed for the location, but owner Llew Sutton was not immediately available for comment.

Moniker Coffee has submitted permit documents to the San Diego Department of Environmental Health and Quality for a new downtown location at 1101 Union Street. No exact opening date has been announced, though the company acknowledged the project when contacted.

New York-based operator Metro Franchising is opening a new Dunkin' location in Meadows Village Plaza, a new retail center in Jacksonville. Plan review paperwork was submitted by Metro Franchising Commissary LLC for the location.

Gary Williams, owner of Just Jerk Jamaican BBQ in Jacksonville, is launching a new food truck concept called Geewiz Fun House Ice Cream. Paperwork was submitted by Williams Estates Group LLC, but Williams was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: Various locations across Canada (Quebec, Alberta, British Columbia, and other provinces)
data.short_description: Tim Hortons' parent company is investing $400 million CAD in 400 renovations and 80 new locations across Canada through 2026. In Quebec specifically, 51 renovations and 14 new restaurants are planned.

The $400 million CAD investment includes 400 restaurant renovations nationwide, with upgrades to dining rooms, digital ordering areas, baked-goods displays, and kitchen equipment. The majority of funding comes from Canadian franchise owners, with Tim Hortons corporate contributing an additional $130 million CAD.

Romanaccia is a new Hollywood restaurant specializing in authentic Roman pizza al taglio, founded by Luca Tartaglia. The menu features long-fermentation dough and imported Italian ingredients, with signature items including a Lasagna Pizza and Nutella Dessert Pizza.

New "coming soon" signage for Saloniki Greek has appeared at the former Regina Pizzeria space on Boylston Street in Boston's Fenway neighborhood. It is currently unclear whether the space will be an additional location or a relocation of the nearby existing Fenway outpost.

data.location: 485 Old Beach Rd, St. Augustine, FL 32080
data.status: in the final stages of building out
data.short_description: The Floridian restaurant, founded in 2010, is in the final stages of building out a new custom location on Anastasia Island after leaving its former home at 72 Spanish Street. The new location will feature 120 seats, expanded indoor and outdoor seating, and a side patio, with an exact opening date announcement expected soon.

data.status: preparing to make its Tampa Bay debut
data.short_description: Arwa Yemeni Coffee, founded in Richardson, Texas in 2021, is opening its first Tampa Bay location in Temple Terrace based on submitted plan review documents. The franchise features traditional Yemeni beverages alongside classic espresso drinks, and the franchisee was not immediately available for comment.

data.location: 513 Cibolo Valley Dr, Suite #113, Cibolo, TX 78108
data.event_date: Construction begins June 1, 2026; completion anticipated September 1, 2026
data.short_description: Playa Bowls is planning a new franchise location at Cibolo Bend Shopping Center, with a 1,345-square-foot space set for a full remodel estimated at $154,281. The project is currently listed as "Project Registered," indicating it is still in early planning and approval stages.

data.location: 30203 Wesley Chapel Blvd, Wesley Chapel, FL 33545
data.short_description: Michigan-founded Wing Snob is planning a new Wesley Chapel location based on submitted plan review paperwork by Snob of Wesley Chapel Inc. The brand currently operates its only Florida location in Riverview and offers a menu of wings, tenders, and 16 sauces.

Two Daughters Bagels is opening a New York-style bagel shop in Largo this August at the Paradise Shops of Largo retail center. The shop will feature specialty coffee, 16 cream cheeses, premium lox, and oversized baked goods, using engineered NYC water chemistry and 36-hour cold fermentation.

Strachan's Ice Cream & Dessert is opening a new location inside Largo's new $85 million city hall building on West Bay Drive, confirmed by both Tampa Bay Business Journal coverage and plan review paperwork. This will be the brand's seventh location, following a recently opened Pinellas Park outpost.

data.location: 1200 El Paseo de Saratoga, San Jose, CA 95129
data.short_description: Sweetgreen is opening a new 2,406 sq. ft. location in West San Jose's El Paseo de Saratoga. The restaurant will be open daily from 10 am to 10 pm and feature produce sourced from California farms. Preview events with complimentary meals were scheduled for May 15–16.

data.location: 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B, Los Angeles, CA 90068
data.short_description: Pita & Pie is seeking an ABC license at 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B in Hollywood. Little information is known about the concept, including menu, design, and opening timeline. Amer Nackoud is behind the concept per the ABC permit filing.

Austin food truck Espadas de Brazil is opening a brick-and-mortar Brazilian steakhouse at 1507 Chestnut St. in Bastrop, in a space that formerly housed Stem & Stone. The brand is hiring for the new location and owner Robinson Figueiredo announced the move on social media.

Seaviche Tacos & Bowls has signed a lease for a third location at 32500 Gratiot Avenue in Roseville. Owner Evan Shina does not have an opening date at this time. The Mexican seafood concept already has locations in Detroit and White Lake.

KP's Kitchen and Bar is closing its Bellaire location on May 31 after a brief run in the Bissonnet Corner area. Owner Kerry Pauly cited a desire to refocus on the original Spring Valley location. The Spring Valley location will remain open.

data.status: plans pointing to a later 2026 opening
data.short_description: Jaggers, operated by Texas Roadhouse, is preparing to open in the former Twin Peaks space at 1915 Hampton Inn Court near Hanes Mall Boulevard in Winston-Salem. The burger-and-shake concept launched in 2014 and already has North Carolina locations in Fayetteville, Greenville, and Jacksonville.

Ike's Café & Grill opened its newest 3,200 sq. ft. location in Marietta with a ribbon-cutting and community celebration on May 8. The African-inspired full-service restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with both indoor and outdoor seating. It is the brand's latest addition following a ghost kitchen concept launched in 2025.

Harvey's Deli, a family-owned East Coast-style sandwich shop in Katy, announced its sudden closure on social media on May 13 after five years in business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited economic struggles and extreme overhead as the reasons for closing.

Esther Rum, a women-owned premium Colombian-imported rum brand, has launched in select locations across Columbus, bottled locally at Echo Spirits. Founded by Margaret Kerr-Jarrett and Emunah Winer, the brand aims to reposition rum as a sippable spirit comparable to tequila.

Ted's Hot Dogs is opening its newest Chandler location on May 23, 2026 with a two-day grand opening celebration featuring giveaways and Buffalo-themed festivities. The fourth-generation family-owned chain, founded in Buffalo in 1927, will introduce the brand's first drive-thru at this location.

data.location: 100 Corte Madera Town Center, Corte Madera, CA 94925
data.short_description: Vietnamese fast-casual chain Asian Box is set to debut at 100 Corte Madera Town Center this fall, per a recent Instagram post. Founded in 2011 by Chad Newton and chef Gracie Nguyen, the chain offers 100% gluten-free, customizable Vietnamese-inspired street food.

Ristobar, a 22-year-old Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, is closing on May 25 (Memorial Day). The Chestnut Street space will continue under a new direction as Eria Marina, a 5,300 sq. ft. indoor-outdoor events venue, through a partnership with Eria Events.

Sushi Kobashi, led by chef Gang Lin previously of the Michelin Star-winning Yoshino team, is preparing to open an eight-seat omakase restaurant at 211 7th Ave. in Chelsea. The experience will feature Chinese-influenced ingredients and premium sake, with prices starting at $250 per guest.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: The hospitality team behind Grove Street Social and Grand Street Social is planning Clarke & Moore Kitchen and Bar at 201 8th Ave. in Chelsea. The first floor will be a 49-seat sit-down restaurant with an elevated pub food menu, while the second floor will serve as a private event space for 74 guests.

data.location: 4400 Post Oak Park Dr (5POP tower, 4400 Post Oak Hwy), Houston, TX 77027
data.short_description: Mack Allen's is a new fine-dining concept debuting as an anchor tenant at the 5POP office tower in Houston's River Oaks–meets–Uptown area, spanning 16,000 sq. ft. on the entire first floor. The restaurant will offer a New American menu with prime beef, wagyu, seafood, and oysters, along with three private dining spaces and a botanical garden patio.

Lou Malnati's South Loop location completed a roughly 2,400 sq. ft. expansion, bringing the total space to 8,400+ sq. ft., while continuing regular operations throughout. The updated space adds a full-service bar, additional dining room seating, and a private events space for up to 50 guests.

Stäge Kitchen & Bar is opening its second location at 110 Campus Way inside Campus 244's Element Hotel by Westin in Dunwoody. After five years in Peachtree Corners, the globally inspired fusion concept is expanding with an omakase bar, curated cocktail program, and a menu of global small plates and entrees.

data.location: 3121–3201 Edwards Mill Rd (Olde Raleigh Village), Raleigh, NC 27612
data.event_date: Late summer or early fall (year not specified)
data.status: targeting a late-summer or early-fall opening
data.short_description: Churp, a new fast-casual healthy bowl concept from Happy + Hale founder Tyler Helikson, is preparing to open at Olde Raleigh Village on Edwards Mill Road. The menu centers around customizable bowls and a dedicated kids bento box menu, with an exact opening date not yet announced.

data.location: Address not specified (operating near 87th Street and Cottage Grove, Chicago, IL)
data.short_description: Gig's Gourmet Baked Potato is a new food truck and catering operation on Chicago's South Side, specializing in gourmet loaded baked potatoes with fine-dining presentation. Founded by chef Gig McFadden after nearly two decades in high-end kitchens, the truck operates Tuesday through Saturday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.

data.location: 3316 SE Federal Highway, Suite A, Stuart, FL 34997
data.status: No official opening date has been announced
data.short_description: C.R. Chicks filed permit applications to open a restaurant at 3316 SE Federal Highway, Suite A in Stuart's Wedgewood Commons Shopping Center. No official opening date has been announced for the Stuart location; separately, a Boynton Beach location is expected to open Fall 2026.

Puff Coffee is preparing to open its second Portland location at 3356 S.E. Belmont St., a space historically associated with Stumptown Coffee Roasters. The cafe is expected to open in July, continuing Puff Coffee's focus on specialty coffee and community atmosphere. This will mark Puff Coffee's second cafe, following its first location opened in 2022 at 2816 S.E. Stark Street.

Texas de Brazil is set to open a new location at The Orchard Town Center in Westminster, Colorado later this year. The Brazilian steakhouse, known for its all-you-can-eat gaucho-style service, is part of a wave of new food and beverage concepts arriving at the outdoor lifestyle mall this summer. The family-owned chain, founded in 1998, operates over 55 restaurants across 23 states.

The Boston Licensing Board approved plans on May 7 for Beehive owner Jack Bardy to transform three former industrial buildings at 202 West First Street into a new restaurant and live entertainment venue called King Bee. The project will include a restaurant, cocktail bars, and live entertainment spaces in South Boston. Many details including design, layout, and entertainment programming are still being refined.

The Reserve Key West, described as a culinary collective, will open inside a converted bank building at 510 Southard Street, just steps from Duval Street. The venue will feature multiple restaurant and cocktail concepts, a rotating bar, and a hidden speakeasy called The Vault housed in the original bank vault. No specific opening date has been announced beyond "coming in 2026."
